en.t: In the first volume of the Nihon Shoki, there is a line that says:

units.source_text: “蹈坚庭而陷股，若沫雪以蹴散。”

en.t: When he steps on the hard courtyard, he sinks to the thighs; like foamy snow, it is kicked apart and scattered.

units.source_text: 意思是说：脚力极大，能把庭中坚石踏陷，蹴成雪粉。

en.t: This means that his leg strength is immense, enough to trample the hard stones in the courtyard down and kick them into powder like snow.
This book was written in classical Chinese.

units.source_text: 故此二句乃抄录，非译文。

en.t: Therefore these two lines are quoted directly, not translated.
